data.long_meaning: Tuhin is a name derived from Sanskrit and Bengali origin meaning 'New Dawn'. It is a beautiful name for a boy, evoking feelings of renewal, hope, and the promise of a bright future. The name Tuhin carries the meaning “New Dawn” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Tuhin usually hope their child will grow to embody new dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
